engine_modules.description: Calculates maximum loan limit for a customer based on income bracket, employment type, tenure, and credit score.
Determines maximum debt-to-income leverage ratio permitted per customer segment (retail, SME, corporate).
Computes a 0–1000 behavioural repayment score from payment history, missed payments, and early settlement events.
Determines whether a customer passes KYC eligibility gates before any credit product can be issued.
Applies dynamic interest rate adjustments based on risk tier, market benchmarks, and promotional flags.
Enforces maximum credit utilization thresholds across a customer's active credit facilities.

strategy_changes.title: Increase loan limit for high-income customers
strategy_changes.natural_language_brief: Customers with monthly income above 15M IDR are hitting the current multiplier ceiling too early. We want to increase the income factor for the 10M–20M bracket from 24x to 27x and add a new bracket at 15M+ with a 28x multiplier to better reflect their repayment capacity.

strategy_changes.title: Adjust leverage ratio cap for SME segment
strategy_changes.natural_language_brief: The SME segment leverage ratio is currently capped at 35%. Following the new OJK circular on SME credit expansion, we need to raise this to 40% for verified SME customers with > 24 months tenure and debt-to-income below 20%.

strategy_changes.title: Reweight early settlement bonus in repayment score
strategy_changes.natural_language_brief: Data shows our early settlement bonus (currently 20 points per event) is under-weighted compared to industry benchmarks. Propose increasing to 35 points per event, capped at 5 events in the lookback window.

strategy_changes.title: Extend KYC eligibility to age 75 for savings products
strategy_changes.natural_language_brief: The current hard age cap of 70 blocks senior customers from accessing long-term savings products. Risk appetite review approved raising the cap to 75 for products classified as SAVINGS_LONG_TERM. PEP and sanctions checks remain unchanged.

strategy_changes.title: Add 3-year loyalty rate discount tier
strategy_changes.natural_language_brief: We currently offer a 0.25% loyalty discount at 36 months and 0.50% at 60 months. Risk and commercial have agreed to add an intermediate tier at 48 months with a 0.375% discount to reduce churn at the 4-year mark.

strategy_changes.title: Lower credit utilization cap from 85% to 80%
strategy_changes.natural_language_brief: Following Q1 arrears data showing elevated risk in the 80–85% utilization band, Risk Committee approved tightening the utilization cap from 85% to 80% for all retail customers. Corporate and SME segments are unaffected.

strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Added 15M+ income bracket at 28x multiplier; raised 10M–20M bracket from 24x to 27x.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: Introducing a distinct 15M+ bracket avoids a cliff-edge jump from 24x to 30x at 20M IDR. The intermediate 28x value was calibrated against the Q4 2025 default-rate cohort data for that income band.

strategy_change_versions.sql_after: WHEN 'sme'       THEN 0.4000  -- raised per OJK circular 2026/04
strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Raised SME base leverage ratio from 35% to 40%.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: Change is scoped to the base ratio lookup only. The conditional tenure and debt checks remain unchanged, so only qualified SME customers (tenure > 24 months, low existing debt) will reach the higher cap.

strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Increased early settlement bonus from 20 to 35 points per event; capped contribution at 5 events.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: Industry benchmark for early settlement weighting sits at 30–40 points. The 5-event cap prevents gaming by customers who split and prepay micro-loans artificially.

strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Analyst reduced bonus per event from 35 to 32 after reviewing back-test score distribution.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: Human edit: back-test showed 35 points over-elevated borderline customers. 32 keeps the score improvement meaningful without crossing approval thresholds artificially.

strategy_change_versions.sql_after:
IF @v_age > 75 AND @p_product_code IN ('LONG_TERM_LOAN', 'SAVINGS_LONG_TERM') RETURN 0;
    IF @v_age > 70 AND @p_product_code NOT IN ('LONG_TERM_LOAN', 'SAVINGS_LONG_TERM') RETURN 0;
strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Extended age cap to 75 for SAVINGS_LONG_TERM product code; other product codes retain 70-year cap.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: The original single-line gate is split into two product-aware conditions. SAVINGS_LONG_TERM customers aged 71–75 can now pass KYC. The stricter cap still applies to all lending products.

strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Added 48-month loyalty tier at 0.375% discount between existing 36-month and 60-month tiers.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: Intermediate tier reduces the 24-month gap in loyalty recognition, addressing the churn spike observed at month 40–47 in retention analytics.

strategy_change_versions.sql_after: DECLARE @v_cap DECIMAL(5, 4) = 0.8000;  -- 80% utilization cap (tightened per Risk Committee 2026-04-20)
strategy_change_versions.diff_summary: Tightened retail utilization cap from 85% to 80%.
strategy_change_versions.ai_rationale: Single-variable change to the cap declaration. All downstream logic (post_drawdown comparison) automatically inherits the new threshold without further modifications.
